common.disclaimer: Civica helps you prepare your SNAP application packet. We do not determine eligibility or approve benefits.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

common.loadError: Unable to load your application. Please try again.

auth.magicLinkSent: Check your email — we sent you a sign-in link.

onboarding.selectState: Which state do you live in?

questions.distressBody: This question asks about financial or housing stress. If you or your household are in crisis, local resources may be able to help immediately.

packet.title: Application status
packet.statusDescDraft: Your application packet is in progress. Answer all questions and upload required documents when you're ready.
packet.statusDescSubmitted: Your packet has been submitted. A navigator will review it soon.
packet.statusDescNeedsDocuments: Your navigator needs additional documents. Please upload them to continue.
packet.statusDescNeedsClarification: Your navigator has questions about your application. Check your inbox.
packet.statusDescInReview: A navigator is reviewing your packet. No action needed from you right now.
packet.statusDescReadyForHandoff: Your packet is ready to be submitted to the SNAP office.
packet.statusDescHandedOff: Your packet has been submitted to the SNAP office on your behalf.

resources.title: Local Resources
resources.intro: If you or your household are experiencing a food or housing crisis, the following organizations may be able to help immediately.
resources.call211Body: Free, confidential referrals to local food, housing, and financial assistance programs. Available 24/7 in English and Spanish.
resources.snapHotlineBody: For questions about SNAP benefits, call your state's SNAP office. California: 1-877-847-3663. Massachusetts: 1-877-382-2363.
resources.foodBankBody: Feeding America's food bank locator can help you find free food near you at feedingamerica.org/find-your-local-foodbank.

consent.title: Review and submit
consent.body: By submitting, I authorize Civica to share my application packet with a SNAP navigator on my behalf. I understand that Civica does not determine my eligibility for SNAP benefits. I can withdraw this consent at any time before the packet is handed off.
consent.checkboxLabel: I have read and agree to the above
consent.withdrawConfirm: Are you sure you want to withdraw? Your packet will return to Draft status.
consent.blockerQuestions: {answered} of {total} required questions answered — complete all questions before submitting.
consent.blockerDocuments: {uploaded} of {total} required documents uploaded — upload all required documents before submitting.
